title: Comparing Misalignment Rates Across Different Harmful Task Domains

original_idea.quick_reasoning: Clearly addresses an AI Safety problem with a reasonably scoped approach.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Identifying which harm domains most reliably induce broad misalignment enables prioritized safety checks. Tests generality of the phenomenon. Clear practical implications for data filtering and safety prioritization.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Requires creating two novel harmful training datasets (chemistry, persuasion) from scratch in addition to the existing insecure code dataset. Dataset creation for harmful domains is non-trivial and requires domain expertise. Three separate finetuning runs on medium compute.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Three separate domains each requiring dataset creation and finetuning. The dataset creation alone for chemistry and persuasion domains could consume most of the 30-hour budget. Scope is too broad without pre-existing datasets.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Novelty not assessed due to partial Wave 3 completion.
